name: Application
purpose: Interactive web, mobile and desktop applications with real product behaviour: people sign in, create and change data, and move through multi-step workflows. Adds feature-level specification, the interaction model and the application architecture.
use_when: People do work in the product: create, edit, manage or transact, not just read.
Screens depend on who the user is and what state their data is in.
The product has several features that each need their own requirements and acceptance criteria.
not_when: The product is mostly published content with a contact form. Use Web.
There is no user interface, only an API or service. Use Backend/API.
A single-page framework is in use. Technology alone never activates a profile.

documents.when: The app works offline, syncs data, or runs background work on the device.
The app team deploys and runs its own services, and no Backend/API profile covers them.
The app ships as an installed client (app store, desktop installer), so older versions stay in use after a release.

checks.name: End-to-end
checks.what: The critical user journeys from the PRD run end to end against a working build.

checks.name: Accessibility
checks.what: Automated accessibility checks on the main screens, against the standard named in DESIGN.md §6.7.
